title: Point cloud wave
description: An ultramarine point sheet rises into a calm three-dimensional swell.
useCase: Data, research, and sound identities where a sampled surface communicates structure.
reducedMotion: A representative frame remains still. Live system preference changes immediately stop the loop; the range control continues to update the still image.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1. A static CSS fallback appears when unavailable or after context loss. Procedural projected points without a mesh engine. The wave is illustrative, not live data.
look: Rows of small ultramarine dots form a wavy perspective sheet across the middle of a flat pale blue-grey field, leaving wide empty margins.
motion: Sine swells travel slowly across 30 rows of perspective-projected points in a continuous rAF loop; the Amplitude slider raises or flattens the swell height live.
adapt: The surface is the `FRAGMENT` shader: the row loop, spacing and `sin` height term shape it, and `u_control` (the Amplitude input via `controlRef`) scales the swell. Swap the dot colour `vec3(.045,.12,.65)` and background `vec3(.88,.90,.92)`; keep the context-loss and reduced-motion handling.
